decisions.label: Cryopreservation
decisions.description: Preservation of cells, tissues, organs, or embryos by storage at low temperatures.

verification.note: NCIT:C16475 Cryopreservation; the NCIT term is the process, while the vocab term is the past-participial state (cryopreserved). Best available NCIT match for the general cryopreservation method.

decisions.term: Cryopreservation in liquid nitrogen - dead tissue
decisions.label: Cryopreservation
decisions.description: Preservation of cells, tissues, organs, or embryos by storage at low temperatures.

verification.note: NCIT:C16475 Cryopreservation; the vocab term specifies liquid nitrogen as the cryogen and dead tissue as the material, which are not captured in the generic NCIT term. Best available match.

decisions.term: Cryopreservation in dry ice - dead tissue
decisions.label: Cryopreservation
decisions.description: Preservation of cells, tissues, organs, or embryos by storage at low temperatures.

verification.note: NCIT:C16475 Cryopreservation; the vocab term specifies dry ice as the cryogen, which is not captured in the generic NCIT term. Best available match.

decisions.term: Cryopreservation in liquid nitrogen - live cells
decisions.label: Cryopreservation
decisions.description: Preservation of cells, tissues, organs, or embryos by storage at low temperatures.

verification.note: NCIT:C16475 Cryopreservation; the vocab term specifies liquid nitrogen as the cryogen and live cells as the material. Best available match.

decisions.label: Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded Tissue Sample
decisions.description: A tissue sample that has been fixed with formalin and embedded in paraffin for long-term preservation and histological analysis.

verification.note: NCIT:C172265 Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded Tissue Sample; the NCIT term describes the resulting specimen type, while the vocab term is the preservation method name (FFPE). No separate FFPE process term found in NCIT. Best available match.

decisions.label: Unbuffered Formalin Fixation
decisions.description: The use of unbuffered formalin for preservation of tissue samples.

verification.note: NCIT:C185402 Unbuffered Formalin Fixation; exact concept match — the vocab term 'Formalin fixed-unbuffered' describes the same fixation method. Minor label inversion.

decisions.label: Buffered Formalin Fixation
decisions.description: The use of buffered formalin for preservation of tissue samples.

verification.note: NCIT:C185403 Buffered Formalin Fixation; exact concept match — the vocab term 'Formalin fixed-buffered' describes the same fixation method. Minor label inversion.

decisions.label: Fresh Specimen
decisions.description: Tissue which has not been exposed to a fixative solution.

verification.note: NCIT:C84517 Fresh Specimen; NCIT term describes the resulting specimen state (not exposed to fixative), while the vocab term is the preservation method label. Best available match for fresh/unfixed tissue.

decisions.term: Fresh dissociated and single cell sorted into plates in NP40 buffer
decisions.label: Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation, Single Cell Sorted into Plates
decisions.description: A tissue preparation process that takes dissociated, sorted cells and distributes them into cell propagation plates.

verification.note: NCIT:C185406 covers the core process (fresh dissociation + single cell sorting into plates). The NP40 buffer specification is not captured in the NCIT term. Best available match.

decisions.label: Optimal Cutting Temperature Compound
decisions.description: A solution of water soluble glycols and resins that provide a specimen support matrix for cryostat sectioning at temperatures of -10 degrees C and below.

verification.note: NCIT:C63523 Optimal Cutting Temperature Compound; OCT is the standard abbreviation for this compound. The NCIT term describes the reagent, while OCT in the preservation context means the specimen was embedded in OCT for cryosection.

decisions.label: Quick Freeze
decisions.description: To freeze rapidly so as to preserve structure and prevent ice crystal formation.

verification.note: NCIT:C63521 Quick Freeze; snap freezing and quick freezing are synonymous — rapid freezing to preserve tissue morphology and prevent ice crystal formation. Label uses 'Quick Freeze' vs 'Snap Frozen' but is the same concept.

decisions.label: Frozen Tissue
decisions.description: A tissue sample that has been frozen prior to analysis.

verification.note: NCIT:C158417 Frozen Tissue; the NCIT term adds 'Tissue' specificity and describes the specimen state, while the vocab term is the generic preservation method. Best available match.

decisions.label: Liquid Nitrogen Storage
decisions.description: An indication that a material has been stored in liquid nitrogen.

verification.note: NCIT:C185338 Liquid Nitrogen Storage; exact concept — biospecimen stored in liquid nitrogen as a preservation method. Label adds 'Storage' but describes the same preservation approach.

decisions.label: Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation
decisions.description: A tissue preparation process that takes fresh tissue and dissociates it into single cell suspensions.

verification.note: NCIT:C185404 Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation; exact concept for fresh tissue dissociation into single cell suspension.

decisions.term: Fresh dissociated and single cell sorted
decisions.label: Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation, Single Cell Sorted
decisions.description: A tissue preparation process that separates fresh dissociated tissue cells into cell populations by single cell sorting.

verification.note: NCIT:C185405 Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation, Single Cell Sorted; exact concept match.

decisions.term: Fresh dissociated and single cell sorted into plates
decisions.label: Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation, Single Cell Sorted into Plates
decisions.description: A tissue preparation process that takes dissociated, sorted cells and distributes them into cell propagation plates.

verification.note: NCIT:C185406 Fresh Dissociated Tissue Preparation, Single Cell Sorted into Plates; exact concept match.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

decisions.label: Not Reported
decisions.description: An indication that the required information was not provided.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.
